items.titulo: AI game clones are making indie developers afraid to show their work
items.resumen: Delayed Steam Next Fest demo is a sign of a growing problem for indie devs.

items.titulo: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
items.resumen: Fed up with ads, tracking and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.

items.titulo: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
items.resumen: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.

items.titulo: Disney found a way to buy Character.AI without buying its lawsuits
items.resumen: Character.AI faces claims its bots encouraged minors to self-harm and kill their parents.

items.titulo: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents
items.resumen: A hacker broke into more than 100 websites using an army of AI agents that mostly operated on their own, according to findings from the AI security firm Norforge. Though Norforge doesn't name the targets, Reuters reports that the victims included companies like John Deere, SharkNinja, and Cummins. Concerns over AI-powered cybersecurity breaches have grown […]

items.resumen: MiniMax has released M3.1 Flash, a 428B-parameter MoE model with about 23B active parameters and a 1M-token context. items.titulo: NVIDIA Open Sources Run:ai Under Apache 2.0 for Kubernetes GPU Orchestration
items.resumen: NVIDIA has released the full Run:ai GPU orchestration platform as open source under Apache 2.0. The release includes KAI Scheduler, CUDA 13.4 GPU fractioning, quota management, and a local Kind dev environment. The post NVIDIA Open Sources Run:ai Under Apache 2.0 for Kubernetes GPU Orchestration appeared first on MarkTechPost .

Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it. llm-tools-datasette was one of those plugins, now fixed. Tags: datasette , llm

Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reasoning tokens into account. items.resumen: The outside watchdog can publish its findings without Anthropic's approval.

items.titulo: Mistral AI Releases Timestral: A 209M Forecasting Model Family That Outperforms Google’s TimesFM-3
items.resumen: Mistral released Timestral, a time series foundation model family from 5M to 209M parameters. The 209M model leads GIFT-Eval, TIME and fev-bench among zero-shot models and runs on CPU. The post Mistral AI Releases Timestral: A 209M Forecasting Model Family That Outperforms Google’s TimesFM-3 appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.titulo: TinyFish Makes Search Free: What It Really Costs an AI Agent to Read the Web
items.resumen: An AI agent that reads the web pays 2 kinds of cost. The first is the retrieval charge: what a search or fetch API bills per request. The second is model processing: content passed from retrieved pages into an AI model consumes tokens, while reasoning and generated responses add further costs.
